insight.headline: IP allowlists are now required for custom apps installed outside your organization
insight.what_changed: We're enhancing protection of merchants by requiring IP allowlists for custom apps, if those apps are installed on stores outside of the organization that owns them. Starting November 20, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET: Apps must have an IP allowlist for new installs. Starting January 1, 2027 at 11:59 PM ET: Allowlists are required for existing installs.
